tagline: MCP servers and tools, in one place.
subtitle: Playbook and tools lists every MCP server and tool, a librarian joins the office, and the app idles lighter.

cards.title: MCP servers and Tools tabs
cards.text: See every MCP server and tool, test whether it connects, turn one off, and set each tool to Allow, Ask or Deny.

cards.title: A librarian joins the office
cards.text: Click her to open Playbook and tools; she shelves new skills and points out a failing MCP tool.

cards.title: Marked-done steps become cards
cards.text: A step you mark done by hand shows as a two-row card, and cards that ask you something keep their top edge in view.

cards.title: Lighter on the battery
cards.text: The stall log is off unless AW_PERF is set, so the app no longer wakes itself about 120 times a second.

also: Delete a skill linked from another folder
Library errors show as pop-up messages
